notes.title: Major Update! Completely Reworked Style!
notes.content:
After long deliberation, we decided that it would be really hard to do Extraktion 1943 justice with the classic pixel art style. SO, after many months of work, here is a sneak peak at our new style.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2631080/extras/g1.gif?t=1703364938[/img]

We hope you like it :) You can also see the updated Trailer on the steam page.

If you haven't already, sign up for our private Beta we'll be running in a few months. It will be the first playable version of Extraktion 1943 and I'd love if you were a part of the process. 

[url=https://chuteapps.com/extraktion-1943-beta/]SIGN UP FOR BETA[/url]

-Carl
